payments.label: Payments add-on
payments.heading: Power your payments with Innoweb
payments.body: Get paid by clients online and in-store with low cost, safe and simple payments.
bullets: Protect against no shows and cancellations
Accept contactless, swipe, chip and pin with an Innoweb card terminal or use Tap to Pay on iPhone or Android.
Receive money in your bank account the very next day.

premium-support.label: Premium Support add-on
premium-support.heading: Get expert help whenever you need it
premium-support.body: Get the most out of the Innoweb platform and its features with help from our experienced business support specialists.
bullets: Phone support with a dedicated number
Live chat with a support specialist at any time
Priority help with setup and features

insights.label: Insights add-on
insights.heading: Understand your business better with Insights
insights.body: Enhance your reports with rich data, control your team's access, and make more profitable decisions for your business.
bullets: Get access to additional premium reports
Create custom reports with the specific data you want to track
Control which reports each team member can access

google-rating-boost.label: Google Rating Boost add-on
google-rating-boost.heading: Increase your footfall with glowing Google reviews
google-rating-boost.body: When your clients give you positive feedback through Innoweb, we'll send them straight to your Google Business Profile to leave a review.
bullets: Any clients rating their experience highly will be prompted to post their review to your Google profile
Increase your rating on Google
Watch your footfall grow

loyalty.label: Client Loyalty add-on
loyalty.heading: Turn all clients into regulars
loyalty.body: Watch your sales skyrocket with a custom loyalty program - encouraging repeat visits and larger purchases.
bullets: Offer the ultimate loyalty experience with points, tiers and referrals
Reward your clients with exclusive offers, discounts and incentives to celebrate their loyalty
Allow clients to easily track their progress and redeem rewards online

data-connector.label: Data Connector add-on
data-connector.heading: Connect Innoweb data to your own data warehouse and BI tools
data-connector.body: Automate data syncing and keep all your essential business systems updated without any manual effort.
bullets: Connect to major data tools, including Power BI, DOMO, Salesforce, Tableau, and many others
Query data directly in your own data tool

client-connect.label: Client Connect add-on
client-connect.heading: Keep clients close with two-way messaging
client-connect.body: Keep clients close with two-way messaging and a shared inbox across web and app, all in one place.
bullets: Reply to client enquiries in real time
One shared inbox for your whole team
Message history on every client profile

team-chat.label: Team Connect add-on
team-chat.heading: Connecting with your team, made easy
team-chat.body: Give your team a dedicated space to collaborate, all without leaving Innoweb. Create groups, share files, and keep every update where it belongs
bullets: Set up custom spaces by location, team or topic
Keep all files, updates and decisions in Innoweb, not buried in external apps
Loved by teams of all sizes - with instant messaging, notifications and privacy controls

bookable-resources.label: Bookable resources add-on
bookable-resources.heading: Manage your resources, rooms and equipment
bookable-resources.body: Set up and track rooms, equipment, and other bookable resources. Assign them to services, set availability schedules, and monitor utilization.
bullets: Assign a resource to your services
Book appointments with no team members, such as a sauna
Track resource utilization with detailed reporting and insights

xero.label: Xero Integration
xero.heading: Connect Innoweb and Xero for easier accounting
xero.body: Automatically sync your sales, payments and expenses with Xero accounting software
bullets: Save hours each week by automatically syncing sales and payments to Xero
Reduce errors and manual entry with automatic categorisation of transactions, taxes and fees

quickbooks.label: QuickBooks Integration
quickbooks.heading: Connect Innoweb and QuickBooks for easier accounting
quickbooks.body: Automatically sync your sales and payments with QuickBooks accounting software
bullets: Save hours each week by automatically syncing sales and payments to QuickBooks
Reduce errors and manual entry with automatic categorisation of transactions, taxes and fees

accounting.readyTitle: Get ready to set up {{name}} accounting
accounting.readyBody: We'll guide you through a few simple steps to connect Innoweb with {{name}} and make sure your financial data is organised correctly

xero.title: Make sure you have a Xero account
xero.body: If you don't have a Xero account set one up

xero.title: Make sure you have permission in Xero to add integrations
xero.body: If you don't have permission, please ask your Xero admin.

xero.title: Make sure your Xero account is set with the Grow plan or above
xero.body: The Grow plan or above gives you unlimited integration capabilities with no limits on number of sales and payments you synchronize between Innoweb and Xero

quickbooks.title: Make sure you have a QuickBooks account
quickbooks.body: If you don't have a QuickBooks account set one up

quickbooks.title: Make sure you have permission in QuickBooks to add integrations
quickbooks.body: If you don't have permission, please ask your QuickBooks admin.

quickbooks.title: Make sure your QuickBooks subscription supports integrations
quickbooks.body: Online subscriptions give you full integration capabilities with no limits on number of sales and payments you synchronize between Innoweb and QuickBooks

accounting.connectBody: Sign in to {{name}} to choose the organisation you want Innoweb to sync with
accounting.connectHint: You will be redirected to a separate tab to connect to {{name}}

Promote your Book Now button on social posts and ads

Track conversions to better understand your business
Build audiences and retarget customers who did not complete a booking.

google-analytics.heading: Track more bookings with Google Analytics

Make data-driven marketing decisions

bullets: Send conversion data to your Google Ads account
Attribute bookings to the ads and keywords that drove them
Build remarketing audiences to retarget clients who didn't complete a booking.

expect.body: To safeguard payouts to your bank account, we need to verify your banking and proof of identity details. These details will not be shared with your clients, or any third party.
